summary: The diff solves the task: `if not isinstance(n, int) or isinstance(n, bool)` enforces the contracted type rules, `if not 1 <= n <= 3999` enforces the range, and the four decimal-place tables produce canonical subtractive Roman strings. Only the to_roman stub changes, preserving exports, is_roman_numeral, and tests; observed test outputs report two existing tests passing and successful checks of all 3999 conversions and error cases.
